title: Certificate of allocation, then felling licence
rule: Two steps: first a certificate of allocation from the District Committee, then a felling licence under the 2004 Regulations.
points: Applicant: a Tanzanian citizen registered as a forest produce dealer, with a business licence, TIN, the technology the Director specifies, and fees paid.
Apply to the District Forest Manager for national reserves and general land, the District Forest Officer for local authority reserves, or the Village Executive Officer for village forests.
Unsuccessful applicants are told in writing, with reasons, within 14 days.
The successful applicant applies for the felling licence with the certificate attached.
The certificate says it is not a felling licence.
Only species named in the harvesting licence may be felled.
src: GN 417 pp. 7 to 8, as amended in 2023
flag: Reg 7(2)(a) still names the District Forest Manager, but the Committee Secretary is now the District Forest Officer. Confirm who receives applications.
